name: jo-wolff-plugins
description: Claude Code and OMP plugins for working with an agent: receipted facts, readable messages, gated pairing, build-or-not checks, handoffs across compaction, an away mode, and more.

plugins.name: output-types
plugins.description: Label only receipted facts, as CLAIM or CITE with the receipt that earns the label, and leave the rest unlabeled; a Stop check warns about any label that has no receipt.

plugins.name: i-have-audhd
plugins.description: How to write to someone who is ADHD and autistic: the rules, the research behind each one, and a Stop hook that warns when a message buries what the reader needs.

plugins.name: paired-coding
plugins.description: Pair with an agent one change set at a time: a card names the decision in each change, you agree in conversation, and a gate at the tool boundary refuses every write outside the agreed set.

plugins.name: ask-graham
plugins.description: Decide whether a new idea is worth building, with one engineer's stated judgment and one verdict. Runs on /ask-graham or "should we build X?", and on every new idea if you opt in.

plugins.name: reminders-review
plugins.description: Go through your open Apple Reminders one at a time with an agent: it answers, confirms before acting, and closes one only on your yes. It can also raise what is due each session. macOS, via remindctl.

plugins.name: pattern-check
plugins.description: Before big work in a repository, make the agent find the existing pattern for each new piece and record reuse, replace or new; hooks hold writes, commits and PRs until that receipt exists.

plugins.name: ledger
plugins.description: A durable record of the questions an agent asks you and the choices it makes without asking, in one SQLite file; hooks keep every question, answer and decision on a row and gate a push on it.

plugins.name: as2-skills
plugins.description: 22 engineering skills (spec and plan, TDD, debugging, code review, security, research and more), most vendored from four upstream skill packs at pinned releases. Skills only, no hooks.

plugins.name: plugin-kit
plugins.description: Scaffold a new plugin for this repository that passes its test bar on day one. Also holds the shared libraries, templates and release-review agents the other plugins copy.

plugins.name: ctx-watch
plugins.description: Notice when the ctx daemon is dead, unsupervised or stale or its index is not ready, repair it, say so at session start and in a macOS popup, and warn when a resumed session skips ctx.

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Teach an agent what a subagent's brief must contain, and refuse a spawn whose brief lacks a required section, naming the section to add. Also ships 11 general agents and 3 delegation guards.

plugins.name: continuity
plugins.description: Keep a long session's state across compaction: ask the agent for a handoff and block one stop until it writes one, snapshot the session before compaction, restore it after, and say if saving works.

plugins.name: brb
plugins.description: Type brb and walk away: the agent keeps working, its questions wait in a digest, and only an on-fire problem reaches you. Claude Code hides its output meanwhile. Type back to read the digest.
